name: What does bathroom finish carpentry include?

mainEntity.name: What does bathroom finish carpentry include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom finish carpentry covers the installation of custom millwork, decorative trim, baseboards, crown molding, vanity cabinetry, window casings, door frames, and built-in shelving. Because bathrooms experience high humidity, finish carpenters use moisture-resistant materials and specialized fastening methods. Adding custom trim framing around vanity mirrors or building recessed linen storage can transform standard drywall into a polished, high-end space while ensuring transitions between tile, drywall, and cabinetry align neatly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom finish carpentry includes installing moisture-resistant baseboards, door and window trim, crown molding, custom vanity surrounds, built-in shelving, and mirror frames.
